paper_title: The ORGAN Experiment: An axion haloscope above 15 GHz
notes: Pathfinding run of ORGAN experiment at 26.531 GHz (110 μeV). Single measured exclusion limit on axion-photon coupling g_agamma = 2.02 × 10^-12 eV^-1 with 90% confidence. Axion mass converted from frequency: m_a = 110 μeV = 1.1 × 10^-4 eV. DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is standard haloscope assumption (mentioned in Stage I projections). This is a narrow-band measurement (2.5 neV span) from a stationary cavity, not a scan. Paper also presents future projections (Stage I and Stage II) but those are marked as 'projected' and not included in the measured limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.95, 1))
